brief.headline: Move to 30-day payment to free up ₹2.25 L cash for us, and ask for a price down to the high-volume band of ₹0.65–0.80/pc on the cap

priceAsk.summary: Target ₹0.65–0.80/pc on the 28 mm induction-wad PP cap
priceAsk.basis: The market asking price for this cap is ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc. At higher volume or looser spec, buyers can reach ₹0.65–0.80/pc — so that band is the defensible benchmark for our volume.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 45 days to 30 days after receipt

brief.financialLeverage: Abhinav publishes no financials, so we can't see their revenue, profit or cash position. Our annual spend with them is ₹27.42 L — a meaningful piece of business for a packaging converter of unknown size. Without financial insight, we build our ask on the market data: caps like theirs trade in a ₹0.55–1.20/pc band, and faster payment is standard industry practice. The plan is to push confidently on both price and terms while qualifying a second source in parallel — the backups below give us walk-away credibility.

evidence.point: We spend ₹27.42 L a year with them — a solid volume anchor for a better price
The open market for a 28 mm induction-wad PP cap runs ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc
Higher-volume buyers reach ₹0.65–0.80/pc on this cap — so our target sits inside the proven range
Cutting payment days from 45 to 30 frees up ₹2.25 L cash for us
HDPE resin import price is 87.61 ₹/kg — a public benchmark to cross-check their raw-material story

risks: Abhinav's financials aren't public, so we can't see if they're healthy or stretched — stay alert for any sign of supply trouble and don't push so hard we destabilise a fragile supplier
We have no internal price comparison (no other vendor for this item) — the ask rests entirely on the market band, so be ready to show them the ₹0.65–0.80/pc evidence if they push back
The backups listed are leads from web research, not qualified sources — start the qualification process now so we have real walk-away power in 60–90 days
If they resist faster payment, offer it as a trade: 30-day terms in exchange for a step toward the ₹0.65–0.80/pc band
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We're spending ₹27.42 L a year with you on caps that the market prices at ₹0.65–0.80 for our kind of volume, and we'd like to move to 30-day payment — let's talk about how we get both those things done.
